Politics · India

Opposition Condemns Police Action Against Jantar Mantar Protestors

Opposition parties and leaders have condemned police action against protestors at Jantar Mantar, including the removal of Sonam Wangchuk. Critics accuse the government of suppressing peaceful dissent and violating rights. The protests involved demands for statehood for Jammu and Kashmir and other issues. Some reports also mention Rahul Gandhi's statement on exam paper leaks.
